accessibility_and_language_note: Partner-distributed voter information should use plain language, keep crucial instructions out of inaccessible image-only formats, and preserve any language or accessibility parity the jurisdiction maintains on the official side.

attribution_and_authority_policy.plain_language_role_statement: This material is shared by a partner. The election office and linked official page or help route control the answer.

delivery_role_note: Community partners may help relay official voter information to audiences the election office cannot reach alone. Action-changing partner-carried materials must identify the authoritative election office, point back to the current official destination, and stay inside approved co-branding and modification boundaries.
partner_distribution_family_label: Example State community-partner voter-information relay lane
